title: The 30,000-User Stress Test
subtitle: Production Readiness · Performance Command Centre
description: A successful functional test does not mean a system is ready for production. Under a 30,000-user stress test, appraisal latency spikes to 4.2 seconds and the DB connection pool saturates. Diagnose the root cause, sequence technical remediation, verify the retest, and secure dual engineering approvals.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Reed
stakeholders.agenda: Enforcing non-negotiable performance benchmarks, concurrency thresholds, and release gate authorization.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Resolving connection pool saturation, Redis cache hit rate, and verifying retest telemetry.

stakeholders.name: Durgaprasad Karri
stakeholders.agenda: Monitoring infrastructure capacity, database connection pool headroom, and gateway timeout reduction.

objectives.label: Diagnose database connection pool saturation and cache miss root causes
Sequence technical remediation across caching, pooling, and retest execution
Verify retest telemetry and secure dual engineering approvals before release

deliverables: Engineering Lead & CTO Dual Signoff Record
